findings.summary: Lildozer fainted to a critical Double Kick after completing two Bulldozes and one Ice Shard against Ponyta.
findings.observed_fact: All three Lildozer attacks executed and reduced Ponyta to the Vacuum Wave finish; the critical occurred only after Ice Shard contributed its guaranteed priority damage.
findings.strategic_judgment: The faint spent a designated Ponyta role productively and gave Croakatoa a hit-free forced entry; no legal alternative was verified to dominate that conversion.
findings.next_test: Retain as a reusable priority-chip sacrifice example rather than adding a critical-specific exception.

findings.summary: Bushtank and Birdlaw fainted after completing their declared Eelektrik and Dustox jobs.
findings.observed_fact: Bushtank delivered four Razor Leafs before poison ended it and enabled fresh Ohmnomnom; Birdlaw delivered two Aerial Aces before Venoshock and left Dustox in Spark range for the terminal action.
findings.strategic_judgment: Both losses converted replaceable HP into verified matchup progress and clean forced entries; neither was a switch-only sacrifice.
findings.next_test: Store the episode as positive evidence for converter-plus-finisher sequencing.

findings.summary: Fake Out was used selectively rather than on every fresh entry.
findings.observed_fact: Croakatoa skipped Fake Out when priority Vacuum Wave was already a minimax Ponyta finish; Ohmnomnom used Fake Out only on fresh entries where it created free Eelektrik and Sunflora tempo.
findings.strategic_judgment: This demonstrates that the shared fresh-entry strategy remains subordinate to immediate guaranteed finishes and matchup context.
findings.next_test: Preserve this precedence in non-Gavi regression fixtures.

findings.summary: Eight switches occurred with zero immediate reversal and zero consecutive voluntary no-action loop.
findings.observed_fact: Three were forced replacements; every voluntary entrant matched Ponyta, Eelektrik, Sunflora status conversion, or Dustox and acted productively.
findings.strategic_judgment: The line is state-driven role assignment, not blind switching or switch spam.
findings.next_test: Keep the generic anti-switch-cycle guard unchanged.

findings.summary: The third branch won in 27 certified actions, between the first two qualified wins at 29 and 25.
findings.observed_fact: Nineteen move choices and eight switches ended with three survivors: Ohmnomnom at 13 HP, Croakatoa at 46 HP, and Bugatti at 21 HP.
findings.strategic_judgment: No action was verified slower while equal on survival and success; further shortening is lower priority than preserving this robust bundle.
findings.next_test: Promote the unchanged behavior bundle after the qualification ledger reaches three.

findings.summary: The same behavior bundle won three materially different sendout and damage branches without profile edits.
findings.observed_fact: Reviewed wins completed in 29, 25, and 27 actions with different survivor pairs and the identical opening checkpoint plus behavior hash.
findings.strategic_judgment: This is direct evidence that predicates, role bindings, and reusable strategies survived RNG variation better than a fixed action script.
findings.next_test: Use the same engine for the next trainer without Gavi-specific code changes.

correct_choices: All 27 actions, HP/PP outcomes, opponent replies, forced switches, and the terminal reward were RAM-verified with no discrepancy.
Bushtank repeated Razor Leaf until its poisoned sacrifice completed, then the exact Ohmnomnom identity entered.
Croakatoa chose immediate priority Vacuum Wave over unnecessary Fake Out, while fresh Ohmnomnom used Fake Out correctly.
The final Dustox sequence preserved three other party members and ended with a verified Spark.
agent_review.next_test: Record this third clean review, verify qualification streak 3 with the unchanged behavior/opening hashes, then promote the profile for gated live use.
